# ZZ docs — llms.txt

> Fast systems language: native AOT, green threads, zero GC pauses.
> Start at docs/README.md. Every `zz` fence is a runnable program.

- [Docs home](README.md): paths for new users vs developers
- [Install](getting-started/install.md): release script, source, managed Zig, doctor
- [Quick start](getting-started/quick-start.md): hello, 60s tour, check/fmt/eval

- [REPL tour](getting-started/repl-tour.md): :help :quit :type :clear, persistence
- [Cheatsheet](getting-started/cheatsheet.md): one-page quick ref
- [Language overview](language/overview.md): values, inference, pipelines, parity
- [Variables and functions](language/variables-functions.md): :=, defaults, generics, closures, methods
- [Control flow](language/control-flow.md): if/if-let, for/while, defer, ?/??
- [Strings](language/strings.md): interpolation, {{ }}, raw backticks, format specs
- [Collections](language/collections.md): arrays, dicts, tuples, slicing, comprehensions
- [Structs and enums](language/structs-enums.md): embedding, impl, generics, recursion
- [Pattern matching](language/pattern-matching.md): match, guards, exhaustiveness
- [Modules](language/modules.md): imports, package vs relative, cycles
- [Operators](language/operators.md): precedence tightest-first, type rules
- [Lexicon](language/lexicon.md): keywords, literals, comments, terminators, fmt
- [Value semantics](language/value-semantics.md): copies, CoW, clone, snapshot isolation
- [Stdlib overview](stdlib/overview.md): module index, namespace rule, Result pattern
- [Built-ins](stdlib/builtins.md): println/len/range/map/int, Option/Result methods
- [String](stdlib/str.md): std.str manipulation, byte offsets
- [Vector](stdlib/vec.md): std.vec array ops
- [Bytes](stdlib/bytes.md): std.bytes buffers
- [Map](stdlib/map.md) / [Set](stdlib/set.md) / [Decimal](stdlib/dec.md): data helpers
- [JSON](stdlib/json.md): parse/stringify/get/as_*
- [CSV](stdlib/csv.md): RFC4180 subset
- [Property](stdlib/property.md): seeded generators + shrinking
- [Colors](stdlib/colors.md): ANSI styling
- [Crypto](stdlib/crypto.md): digests, HMAC, passwords, signatures, JWT
- [Encoding](stdlib/encoding.md): base64, hex, URL codecs
- [UUID](stdlib/uuid.md): v4/v7 generation, parse, validate
- [Log](stdlib/log.md) / [Sys](stdlib/sys.md) / [Term](stdlib/term.md): OS/terminal
- [Args](stdlib/args.md) / [Env](stdlib/env.md) / [Process](stdlib/process.md): env/CLI/process
- [FS](stdlib/fs.md) / [Path](stdlib/path.md): filesystem + lexical paths
- [HTTP](stdlib/http.md): server/routing/middleware/static/TLS/client/test
- [Net](stdlib/net.md): TCP, timeouts, binary-safe reads, TLS, Unix
- [Cell](stdlib/cell.md): shared-mutable slots
- [Regexp](stdlib/regexp.md): compile/is_match/find/replace/captures
- [SQL](stdlib/sqlz.md): sqlz sqlite/postgres/mysql, transaction
- [Chan](stdlib/chan.md) / [Task](stdlib/task.md): concurrency
- [Test](stdlib/test.md): asserts, temp dirs, snapshots, doctests
- [Math](stdlib/math.md) / [Time](stdlib/time.md): numerics, clocks, dates
- [Stdlib reference](stdlib/reference.md): generated 691 entries with signatures across 42 groups
- [CLI](tooling/cli.md): run/build/watch, clean/cache/toolchain
